name: nxsched_foreach

ownership.argument: This is the task iterator the loop capture needs: callback signature is (tcb, arg), matching what astrolink already uses. Note the iteration visits one TCB per pid-hash bucket, so on this build the hash carries a single TCB per bucket; if a bucket ever chains, the chain is not followed here.

provenance.source: Exact 3.101.036 AP producer/consumer and data-layout review; see p67-036-native-contract.md.
